heading: RBI Hikes Repo Rate by 25 bps: Your Home Loan EMI Impact
tldr: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) increased the repo rate by 25 basis points to 5.50% on October 7, 2026.
This hike directly impacts home loan interest rates, especially those linked to external benchmarks.
Borrowers may see their Equated Monthly Instalments (EMIs) increase or their loan tenure extended.
Understanding your loan's interest rate type (EBLR or MCLR) is crucial to assess the immediate impact.
Reviewing your home loan statement and considering options like prepayment or balance transfer is advisable.
caption:
Heads up, homeowners! The RBI just made a move that could affect your home loan EMI. If you have a home loan, especially one that changes with market rates, you might see a small increase in your monthly payment or your loan period getting longer. Our latest article breaks down what this means for you and what you can do. Read more here.
